text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated p50/p95 latency on streaming responses (SSE) across hosted-api-usw2. Autoscaler healthy but backpressure observed on worker kv-cache. Triggering incident channel. thread_ts=1719994321

Maya Patel: seeing it. p95 for /v1/stream is 1.8s higher than baseline and we have dropped throughput on some backends. paging SRE rotation.

Ajay Singh: tagging @SRE Rotation - can we consider quieting SSE channels for hosted tier temporarily? non-streaming JSON responses should still work. aim is to reduce connection churn and relieve kv-cache thrash.

SRE Rotation: on it. quick checklist: 1) warn oncall, 2) flip feature flag to disable push frames, 3) apply short TTL rate limits for streaming clients, 4) route traffic to non-streaming path.

Lina (DevOps): I can flip the flag. internal feature API: 
```
curl -X POST https://infra-internal.redwood/api/flags/streaming -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN" -d '{"enabled":false, "reason":"incident-1719994321"}'
```
I also have an nginx snippet ready to 410 the /v1/stream endpoint if needed.

Maya Patel: do it in this order: flag -> soft 410 on proxy for a minute -> monitor -> broader routing change if needed. call it 'quiet sse' not 'shutdown' in comms.

DeployBot: Deploy started for feature-flag change (deploy-id: df-5821).

Lina (DevOps): feature flag flip initiated. will confirm when rolled.

Ajay Singh: adding a quick rate-plan: set per-key streaming_conn_limit=1 and short burst bucket=5 requests/min for 10m window. this prevents clients from reconnecting aggressively.

SRE Rotation: paging policy: primary oncall -> Maya Patel, secondary -> Ajay Singh. handoff ETA 5m. @Oncall Bot, please escalate to infra if we see >5% error rate on non-streaming endpoints.

Oncall Bot: Pager sent to Maya Patel. escalation if not acknowledged in 120s.

Ben - Customer Success: what is customer visible impact? are we returning truncated responses or switching to polling? need copy for top customers.

Maya Patel: customers will see fewer streaming chunks; they'll get final response once complete (streaming suppressed). No data loss. We'll post to status.redwood: 'We are temporarily suspending streaming chunks to stabilize latency; full responses continue to be generated.' Drafting message for top 20 customers and support playbook.

Lina (DevOps): feature flag responded OK. DeployBot: feature-flag rollout complete at 1719994400.

DeployBot: Proxy change applied (canary) on api-host-3.

Ajay Singh: metrics: within ~30s of the flag flip, connection churn dropped ~38% and kv-delta errors dropped. p95 for non-stream requests stable. still seeing occasional slow tails on long sequences (>=1024 tokens).

SRE Rotation: performing routing switchover for remaining hosts in waves of 2 to avoid cascading. Wave 1 done. Monitoring CPU/GPU queues.

Maya Patel: good. hold for 10 minutes and reassess. If stable, we keep streaming suppressed and run followups: longer-term fix: KV cache sizing and per-model seq-length throttles.

Ben - Customer Success: preparing status message and customer email. will flag any enterprise customers with active deployments.

Ajay Singh: small rollback plan if customers need streaming back immediately: flip flag true and throttle reconnects via nginx 503 with Retry-After header. rollback script: 
```
# if needed
curl -X POST https://infra-internal.redwood/api/flags/streaming -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN" -d '{"enabled":true, "reason":"rollback-1719994321"}'
```

SRE Rotation: marking this incident as mitigated for live degradation at 1719994510, but keep channel open for postmortem and follow-up tasks.

Maya Patel: I'll take lead on incident writeup and link to runbook for "sse quiet". Please add any metric screenshots and the KV cache heap dump to the ticket.

Lina (DevOps): capturing logs and creating artifact bundle.

DeployBot: Canary checks green. final proxy roll at 1719994660.

Ajay Singh: final note: set a short-term quota bump for text-generation non-streaming to absorb clients that expected streaming. apply 10% more tokens/min for 30m.

SRE Rotation: confirmed. no major customer escalations so far. Ben, please route support traffic to "streaming-suppressed" triage queue.

Ben - Customer Success: ack. drafting top-10 email and support playbook.

Maya Patel: thanks team. action items: (1) post status page, (2) incident ticket and PM for follow-up, (3) runbook updates for automatic quieting thresholds. keeping channel open until postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:
